evidence: p080.png (printed p.78) 480b colors the ligature «لَا» of «لَاحَ» in red (with «حَ» in black), and pack/B/c06.md R1 [half b, 24:27, code=ل] spans «لَا». By v.45–46 and Wafi b480 («المرموز له باللام وهو هشام»), only the initial letter «لَ» is the code letter for هشام.
reasoning: Single-letter رمز «ل» (هشام) is over-extended to cover two letters «لَا» in «لَاحَ» because of the lam-alif ligature in the PDF; the span should cover only the code letter «لَ».
